book.name: 1 Timoseo
book.title: Ɨnyarʉbha ye embere ya Paaurʉ kwa Timoseo

content: Nangʉ Ekoro ɨragamba ɨtakubhisa, muzisikʉ za rusizʉ, abhandɨ bharatiga ubhwisirirya bhwa amaheene, na kutuna zekoro zʉ ʉbhʉkangirirya, na amiija ga Shɨtaani.
Amiija gayo, gariijibhwa abhabhɨ, abhabhɨɨhi bhanʉ zekoro zaabhʉ zikuurɨ zangɨ nkina zʉchirwɨ ni ichʉma cho omorero.
Bhayo bhararecha abhandɨ bhatigɨ kukwɨra, hamwɨ kurya ibhyakurya ɨbhɨndɨ. Nawe Mungu akabhɨbhʉmba korereke bhɨsʉngʼaanwɨ kubhukumya na abhiisirirya, kʉ kʉbha bhɨɨzɨ amaheene.
Ebhegero bhyʉsi bhya Mungu, nɨ‑bhɨzʉmu, kɨtareeho cha kwangwa. Bhyʉsi bhɨsʉngʼaanwɨ kubhukumya,
kʉ kʉbha ebhegero bhiyo bhɨbhɨngukiibhwɨ nɨ ɨngʼana ya Mungu na amasabhi gɨɨtʉ.
Ʉraabhahɨ abhiisirirya bhʉʉsi amiija ganʉ, hayo neho ʉkʉbha omohocha ʉmʉzʉmu wa Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ. Na ʉrabha ʉrɨrirwɨ bhwaheene mʉmaheene gu ubhwisirirya bhwɨtʉ na mumiija amazʉmu ganʉ ʉgatunirɨ.
Ʉtaanɨ na amaganʉ ganʉ gatarɨ ga Mungu ganʉ gataana nzobhooro, nawe wiinaryɨ kwikara chɨmbu Mungu akwenda.

Ɨmɨnyɨkɨɨnɨ, “Kʉnarya ʉmʉbhɨrɨ kobhona amanaga, kunu ubhwera bhusuuhubhu. Nawe, ukwinarya kwikara chɨmbu Mungu akwenda, kunu ubhwera bhwa teemwa zʉʉsi, kʉ kʉbha rɨnʉ rɨratoha ʉbhʉragɨ bhwo okobhona ʉbhʉhʉru bhwa nangwɨnʉ na bhʉnʉ bhukuuza.”
Ringʼana riyo ni‑rya amaheene, na abhaatʉ bhareenderwa kʉrɨsʉngʼaana.
Riyo neryo rikugirya turiikongʼeererya na kokora emeremo kumucha, kʉ kʉbha tʉramwisega Mungu wʉ ʉbhʉhʉru, Ʉmʉsabhuri wa abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi, kɨnda bhanʉ bhakumwisirirya.
Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi atakorega kʉ kʉbha awɨ ʉkɨɨrɨ mumura, nawe okore umucha ʉbhɨ ekerenjo kubhiisirirya kʉkʉgamba, koteemwa, kʉbhʉsɨɨgi, kubhwisirirya no obhoronge.
Kora umucha kosomera abhaatʉ Amaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu, na urwazɨ nu ukwija, kuhika hanʉ nikuuza iyo.
Ʉtatiga kohokerya ʉbhʉnaja bhʉnʉ Mungu akʉhɨɨrɨ kʉhɨtɨra amangʼana gʉ ʉbhʉrʉʉti, hanʉ watɨɨrɨɨrwɨ amabhoko na abhiimiiririri bha risengerero.
Ugwatɨ amangʼana gayo, korereke abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bharore umucha gwazʉ mubhwikari bhwazʉ.
Wangarɨrɨ eteemwa yaazʉ na amiija gaazʉ, na ongʼehe kokorabhu. Hanʉ okokora gayo uriisabhʉra awɨ aumwene na bhanʉ bhakukwitegeerera.
